title: Law to require discounted parks fees for more groups
summary: This bill would require the Parks Department to charge reduced admission and membership fees at all its recreational facilities, including museums, zoos and botanical gardens, to seniors, young adults aged 18 to 24, people with disabilities, veterans, and active military members and their minor children. It expands current discounts beyond community recreation centers and extends them to veterans' and service members' children. The reduced fee would be capped at 25 percent of the highest fee charged, and the law would take effect 180 days after passage.
